audio_label: Dua Lipa • Levitating (feat. DaBaby) [Don Diablo Extended Remix]
caption:
“Levitating” by Dua Lipa, released on October 1, 2020 through Warner Records as the fifth single from her second studio album Future Nostalgia — ￼ and it was actually the very first song recorded for the album. She started here. And it became everything. 🚀🔥

After figuring out the sound she desired for Future Nostalgia, Dua Lipa began working backwards — and “Levitating” was the first track recorded that made the album’s final cut. ￼ A song that set the entire blueprint for one of the greatest pop albums of the decade. The foundation. The blueprint. The moment everything clicked. 💙✨

“Levitating” made history as the longest-charting Billboard Hot 100 hit ever among women ￼ — and was crowned the number one Billboard Hot 100 song of the entire year 2021. It also became the first Diamond-certified hit by a female vocalist of the decade — the RIAA’s highest possible certification. ￼ Disco-pop, zero gravity, and a record that simply refused to land. 👑🌍

🌟 If you wanna run away with me — “Levitating” is Dua Lipa at her most joyful, most unstoppable and most iconic — a song that floated to the top of every chart and never came back down. 🎶
